newsitem.title: USA: Maine police investigate multi-state carjacking.
newsitem.headline: Maine police investigate multi-state carjacking.

text.p: Police were hunting Friday for a gunman who allegedly kidnapped a motorist in Pennsylvania and forced him to drive hundreds of miles to Maine before stealing the car.

Joseph Caviston, 34, said he was stopped at a traffic signal on Route 6 in Carbondale, Pa., Thursday when a man got in the car and forced him at gunpoint through six states, according to Maine state police.

The gunman forced Caviston out of the car along Interstate 95 south of Augusta Thursday evening, stole $200, hit him on the head and drove off with the vehicle, a dark blue 1987 BMW with Pennsylvania plates, according to the state police.
Police said Caviston was treated for a bump on the head at a local hospital and released. He returned to Pennsylvania with a relative Friday.

The suspect was described as about 6 feet, 175 pounds with a full beard and shaggy brown hair. He was being sought on charges of armed robbery and kidnapping, and was considered dangerous, police said.
